sloka: जनस्थाने हत स्थाने तव राक्षस मत् शरैः ।निर्भया विचरिष्यन्ति सर्वतो मुनयो वने ॥३-३०-९॥
transliteration: janasthāne hata sthāne tava rākṣasa mat śaraiḥ ।nirbhayā vicariṣyanti sarvato munayo vane ॥3-30-9॥

translations.english: O demon, when my arrows destroy your hold over Janasthana the sages will move freely without fear all over this forest.
